packageRules.description: compose-ai-tools ships the preview CLI, the ee.schimke.composeai Gradle artifacts (the preview-annotations dependency and the ee.schimke.composeai.preview plugin marker) and the reusable CI actions/workflows as a single release. Group the pinned action refs and the Gradle coords into ONE PR so the CLI, plugin and annotation pins can never skew apart — a skew breaks preview discovery outright. Track it aggressively and automerge once CI is green: the release moves several times a day and the pin is only useful if it keeps up. Republishing the catalog against the new renderer needs no extra step, because design-artifacts.yml has a push trigger on main covering the manifest paths this PR touches.

Compose Multiplatform and its independently-versioned Material 3 artifact move together; a mismatched pair drags in a foundation version the other half wasn't compiled against. One PR so CI judges them as a unit.
